future_margin_axis.tail_handling: tail mass is retained separately from visible bins

loopy_bp_caveat: The focal preseason prior is absent as a direct factor; loopy cycles can leave indirect feedback.

performance_percentile.reference_population: eligible FBS team-game performances included by this snapshot
performance_percentile.tie_handling: half credit for equal expected rank

rating_definition: normalize(single-game Historical Likelihood × opponent pair-cavity belief)
rematch_definition: All games in a grouped head-to-head pair use the same pair cavity; each game is rated independently.

conditional_game_model.distribution: Student-t residual conditional on fixed latent ranks
conditional_game_model.shared_game_result: one canonical game outcome is shared by home and away in each rollout

latent_quality.draw_unit: one rank per modeled team per outer universe
latent_quality.joint_posterior_approximation: marginal-independence V1 approximation; sampled ranks need not be a permutation
